+        datasets_with_var = [ds for ds in datasets if var_name in ds.variables]
+        if datasets_with_var and len(datasets_with_var) < len(datasets):
+            # This variable is missing from some datasets, fill it in
+            template_var = datasets_with_var[0].variables[var_name]
+            for ds in datasets:
+                if var_name not in ds.variables:
+                    # Create a NaN-filled variable with the same dims and dtype

+                        for d in template_var.dims
+                    )
+                    filled_data = np.full(fill_shape, fill_value, dtype=template_var.dtype)
+                    ds.variables[var_name] = Variable(template_var.dims, filled_data, template_var.attrs)
